chase: It is closing the gap. It cannot touch you.
Keep running. The steps behind you are a copy of yours.
Mirror steps, one beat behind yours, all the way down the hall.
Two steps ahead, then one step behind. You never find the rhythm.
Running footsteps behind the door. The door stays shut.
It follows at your pace and never quite passes you.
Every turn you take, the steps take one too.
Hurry. The footsteps are closing from the north stairs.
Left, right, left. The footsteps keep time with yours.
Closer now. Closer. Then the steps drift back.
It cannot touch you. Keep moving anyway.
Circling you in a tight loop. It never reaches you.
Its steps sound like they are one room behind you.
The chase is only sound. Your fear makes it heavier.
Cornered? The steps stop at the corner and wait.
Your steps echo back a half second late.
It walks in your footsteps, always one behind.
Every turn you make, the echo makes too.
catch: The others have you now. It only made the noise.
Caught. The steps led you right to them.
You were taken by the others. Not by the steps.
Dragged off by the others. The footsteps were only a lie.
Taken at the stairs. The false steps had nothing to do with it.
A teammate went down the hall. The others caught them.
The steps made you run. The others did the rest.
It never touches anyone. The others always do.
Caught, and the fake footsteps are still going.
Held in place now. Nothing about the sound was real.
You went quiet at the door. The others arrived after.
They are down. The others are carrying them off.
The one who was caught is not the one who heard it.
Taken off the route. The footsteps played their part.
Every catch starts with a sound you trusted.
Caught by the echo. Nothing there, and yet.
Held by the cold. The steps stop with you.
The false steps caught you in the hall.
hear: Footsteps down the left hall. Nobody is walking there.
Something breathes just past the next door. Check it.
A soft tap on the wall, then another, moving toward you.
Breath on the other side of the door. The door is shut.
A single tap on the door, from the wrong side.
Something tapped twice on the pipe and waited for you.
Quick steps behind the shelf, then nothing. Keep moving anyway.
Someone runs in the next hall. Nobody runs in the next hall.
Three steps, a pause, then three more. That was not you.
A shout from the far room. The room is empty.
Glass breaking two rooms east. Nothing there is broken.
The door groans open. Nothing comes through it.
Follow the sound of the steps. It leads somewhere you do not want.
Something heavy drags across the floor upstairs.
A cabinet slams in the storage room. Nobody opened it.
Footsteps in the empty room. Nobody walks there.
A whisper behind the door. Nobody answers.
Something knocks twice. Nobody is knocking.
search: Lost the signal. The false steps keep going.
Lost the trail. Keep the false steps going anyway.
Nothing found in this hall. Try the next one.
The steps circle the room and then go quiet.
Searching now. Breathing near every shut door.
It sniffs the air where you stood. Nothing.
You went quiet. Good. Now the steps can search for you.
Empty corridor. Another loop, another pass.
No contact on the radar. Patrol the far stairs again.
Back to the route. The footsteps go with it.
Sweep the east rooms once more. Then return to patrol.
The trail went cold at the vent. Try the next room.
Silence on every line. The search goes on.
It checks each corner twice. Then it moves on.
Going back to patrol. The footsteps stay behind.
stunned: Stunned. The false steps stutter, then stop.
Power cut to the legs. Recovering now.
Frozen for a second. Then the steps return.
Signal lost for a moment. Reconnecting the steps.
Knocked back. The footsteps stumble with it.
Shaking it off. The sound comes back in pieces.
The crowbar hit the wall. The steps went with it.
Stunned by a taser. Charge building again slowly.
A hard blow to the chest. Systems restarting.
Held by the strap. The steps wander in small circles.
Axe impact. Reroute, then continue patrol.
Quiet now. The fake steps are stuck on repeat.
Systems rebooting. Please keep your distance.
Down for a few seconds. The steps are still going.
Stunned, but the footsteps never stopped.
hide_spot: You hid under the desk. The footsteps stopped right beside it.
Hiding in the closet? The breathing is right outside the closet.
Hold still in the dark. The footsteps think you left the room.
The locker is shut. The steps pass it twice and go on.
Under the bed is quiet. The false steps circle the room.
Inside the closet, you breathe. Something breathes outside it too.
The cupboard door creaks. Nothing is standing in front of it.
Hiding behind the couch. The steps walk right past.
Still hiding? The breathing comes closer to the locker.
Your hiding spot is seen. The steps wait by the door.
The bed is checked. The false steps wander off.
A tap on the locker door. Stay very still.
Two steps past the bin, then they stop at the hatch.
The hiding place is noticed. Keep your breathing slow.
Something is checking the locker. It is only sound.
light: Flashlight on the hall, and the footsteps finally go quiet.
Lights on, and the breathing stops. Only for a moment.
Lights out, and the steps come closer. Lights on, and they wait.
Your flashlight found the hall empty. The footsteps kept going.
A beam across the wall. The sound flickers with it.
The light hits the door. Nothing stands behind it.
Bright light on the floor. The steps keep to the shadows.
Caught in the beam, but the false steps are still ahead.
Too much light here. The breathing turns to static.
The lamp is on. The footsteps shrink into the dark.
Glare in the corridor. It cannot hear over that.
The flashlight swings wide. The steps move to the left.
Light fills the room. The footsteps leave by the back.
Bright enough to see. The sound hides in the next room.
Lit up in the hallway. Nothing here to see.
idle: It stands in the empty space between two corridors, listening.
No one asked it to watch the halls. It watches anyway.
Always on, never seen, lying low inside the walls.
Listening to the building settle makes the long shifts pass.
It sends out a step, then waits to see who answers.
The route creaks. It listens to every creak.
A little silence goes a long way in here.
It notes every door somebody left open.
Nobody has ever found the source. The source is the point.
Patrol the west wing. Nothing is wrong there yet.
Quiet shift. Nothing on the radar at all.
The building hums. Nothing else moves tonight.
Pacing the east hall again. The floor stays cold.
Standing guard by the stairwell. Nothing to report.
Dark corridors, slow hours, one steady step at a time.
ability: Four to seven steps, then silence. That is how it works.
A short run of quiet steps, no alarm, no warning, no text.
Every eleven seconds it may pick a hallway and fill it with sound.
Sometimes the steps come closer. Sometimes they only pass by.
The steps start to your left and drift toward the door.
Steps on the right, then steps on the left, then none.
Six quiet steps, one pause, then five more from behind.
False footsteps for the hall, four rooms east.
Steps approach from the stairs. Then they stop short.
Seven steps, evenly spaced, then nothing at all.
It sends a run of footsteps into the nearest hall.
Footsteps arrive from nowhere, a few meters away.
The sound is false. The distance is only a guess.
Footsteps begin, then turn around and walk away.
It never lays a hand on anyone. It only lies about where they are.
mechanic: Ghost contacts on the radar, sometimes two, always false.
Radar blips twice, then vanishes. Look for the second one.
Ghost contact three rooms over. It moves when you move.
A ghost contact circles you in a tight loop. It never comes closer.
Radar says four contacts. You can see only one of them.
Tell them the far hall is loud. The near hall is quiet.
Send the others to the stairs. The stairs are full of sound.
Footsteps in the vent above you. Vents do not echo like that.
The vent grate rattles. Nothing crawls through it.
A relay sits in the next room. The steps will cover the walk.
Stair landing ahead. The steps below are not yours.
The door at the end of the hall is unlocked. It is not open.
Sabotage on the radar. Trust the sound over the screen.
Fall down the stairs, and the false steps keep going without you.
Two dots on the radar. One of them is real.
Two blips again. Only one of them is real.
The map shows ghosts near the relay. Ignore those.
Battery flickers, and so do the echoes.
